stem: Avni models $(-3)\times(+4)$ with a token bag that starts empty. Positive tokens are $+1$ and negative tokens are $-1$.

options.text: Call the model the word bag only, with no tokens placed or removed.
Place three negative tokens, and do that placing four times, for twelve negative tokens in all.
Place three negative tokens four times even when the bag is not allowed to hold negative tokens.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Multiplying −3 by +4 means taking the group of three negative tokens and placing that group four times, which fills the bag with twelve negative tokens.

teacher.key_rationale: (+4) repeats placing the (−3) group four times, giving twelve negative tokens. Naming bag alone, or dropping that negative tokens are allowed, miss the token-bag reading.
